Mission Local reported that a 16-year-old boy spent almost three weeks in San Francisco County Jail after allegedly giving law enforcement a false name and birthday. The city took 20 days to verify he was a minor, and he was kept apart from other inmates while awaiting a judge’s decision. The story said he was later ordered transferred to juvenile hall on $10,000 bail.
